content: [Slack #security-alerts Eve Liu Mon Jul 01 2024 08:30] 🚨 CRITICAL: CVE-2024-6387 (regreSSHion) just dropped. Qualys says ~14 million internet-facing OpenSSH instances potentially vulnerable. CVSS 8.1, affects 8.5p1 through 9.7p1. Patch is OpenSSH 9.8p1 released today. Dave: please start scanning our Shodan data.

Alert received. CVE-2024-6387 is a critical OpenSSH vulnerability. Starting assessment of our exposure. CVSS 8.1 (High), unauthenticated remote code execution. Will coordinate with Bob on internal inventory scan.

[Slack #security-alerts Dave Chen Mon Jul 01 2024 09:15] Quick note on formatting for the incident team: CVE IDs should always be written as CVE-YYYY-NNNNN format with hyphens and uppercase. I just saw someone write 'cve2024-6387' in a ticket — let's be consistent. Also I'll have initial Shodan data analysis ready by EOD.
Noted on CVE ID formatting — will use CVE-2024-6387 consistently (CVE-YYYY-NNNNN, hyphenated, uppercase). Awaiting Dave's Shodan analysis.

[Slack #security-alerts Dave Chen Mon Jul 01 2024 14:00] BOT_SUMMARY from our CVE monitor: CVE-2024-6387, roughly 30 mins lab exploitation, affects ~8 million internet instances. [AUTO-GENERATED, NOT VERIFIED] Note: this is auto-summarized from RSS feed, take with grain of salt.

BOT summary noted but marked as NOT authoritative. Will verify numbers against Qualys primary report and NVD. The Qualys report states 14 million instances and 6-8 hours lab exploitation time — very different from the bot's numbers.
